id_and_class.summary: David Chalmers argues that consciousness may be a fundamental feature of physical reality, carried by the intrinsic properties of its most basic entities. He treats panpsychism, and its cousin panprotopsychism, as a synthesis of materialism and dualism, and holds that it would become the most promising answer to the mind-body problem if someone solves the combination problem.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as the Intrinsic Nature of Physics

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Chalmers identifies consciousness with the intrinsic properties of fundamental physical entities, the categorical bases of the dispositions that physics describes. Physics tells us what basic entities do; on this view, phenomenal or protophenomenal properties are what they are.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Mind and matter are two sides of one fundamental stuff that has both physical and phenomenal properties. Chalmers places this ‘monism’ in the sixth of his six classes of views, the nonreductive ones that expand or reconceive physical ontology.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable at the base level (phenomenal or protophenomenal properties are fundamental); human experience would be constituted from them, by a process the combination problem leaves unexplained.
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Chalmers takes subjective experience as a datum that cannot be deflated into an illusion. He does not give a separate account of intentionality.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Qualia are real and irreducible. In the panpsychist version they exist in simple form at the fundamental level; in the panprotopsychist version, basic entities have protophenomenal properties that are not themselves experiences but can ground them.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Fundamental physical entities whose intrinsic nature is phenomenal or protophenomenal, plus the physical dispositions those natures ground.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: We know consciousness directly from the first person and know physical entities only by their causal and structural roles, which leaves room for experience to fill in their intrinsic nature.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Micro-level phenomenal or protophenomenal properties are the building blocks. How they combine into a single human subject is the open combination problem.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal consciousness and its place in nature
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Chalmers reasons dialectically. Materialism (thesis) meets dualism (antithesis) and yields panpsychism; panprotopsychism challenges it and yields Russellian monism; the combination problem then challenges Russellian monism, with no settled resolution yet.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness is a standing feature of fundamental reality, not something that switches on. Rich experience in brains would come from combining micro-level properties, a step Chalmers has not specified.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Throughout physical reality, at the level of its most basic entities.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Because phenomenal or protophenomenal properties are the categorical bases of physical dispositions, consciousness sits at the base of physical causation itself.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Unresolved. Explaining how many micro-subjects or micro-properties form one unified experience is the combination problem, which Chalmers names as the main obstacle.
core_claims_and_evidence: To place consciousness in nature we must either revise our conception of consciousness or revise our conception of nature, and Chalmers declines to deflate consciousness.
Physics describes only the dispositions of basic entities, so their intrinsic, categorical nature is open to being phenomenal or protophenomenal.
Chalmers frames panpsychism as a synthesis of materialism and dualism and finds good reason to take both panpsychism and panprotopsychism very seriously.
A reasonable solution to the combination problem would make either view the most promising solution to the mind-body problem.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Philosophical (conceptual argument about the hard problem and the limits of physical description)

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The combination problem is the central difficulty, and Chalmers concedes it is unsolved. He also calls panpsychism initially counterintuitive, holding that the sense of oddity fades on reflection.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Whether panpsychism or panprotopsychism is the better form, and whether any solution to the combination problem exists. Chalmers has also explored quantum and idealist theories without fully committing to any one view.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Coherent as a form of monism that keeps physics intact and adds intrinsic natures to it. Its standing depends on bridging micro-level properties and macro-level experience.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Since every physical system has phenomenal or protophenomenal properties at its base, an AI is built from the same ingredients as a brain. Whether it forms a unified conscious subject depends on how the unsolved combination problem is answered.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: The fundamental properties outlast any body, but nothing in the view says whether the particular combined subject survives once the brain's structure breaks down.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Placing experience in the basic fabric of nature gives it a cosmic footing, but Chalmers draws no conclusions about meaning or purpose.

virtual_immortality.rationale: An upload would be made of the same fundamental properties, but whether it reconstitutes the same subject turns on the unsolved combination problem.
